name: Gold Finger
source: PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
body:
Drawbacks
Gold Finger
Source PFS Guide to Organized Play 6.0 pg. 14
Category Faction
Your family comes from a long, proud tradition of housebreaking and thievery. You are a strong part of that tradition. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Disable Device and Sleight of Hand checks, and one of these skills (your choice) becomes a class skill for you.
